home.p1: I’m a full-stack developer who builds web and mobile apps <mark>end to end</mark>. I think about the interface, the API and the database together, and I take a product from idea to launch.
home.p2: I work with Next.js, React Native, Node.js and TypeScript, and I care about writing simple, fast and maintainable code.

page.p1: When I build a feature, I like to think about the screen, its API and its data model together. That’s why I don’t stay on one side of a project: I work across all of it, from the frontend to the backend and from the database to launch.
page.p2: I took my own startup, Sunflow, from idea to launch on my own. It taught me to think not only about a product’s code, but also about the people who use it and how it works day to day.
page.p3: In my free time I build small projects with microservices, message queues and new tools. I keep learning and improving.

michat.lead: A messaging app I built with a microservice architecture inside a Turborepo monorepo.

diagram.caption: Architecture
diagram.label: miChat architecture: the Next.js web app talks to an API gateway, which routes requests to the user, chat and mail services. Shared packages hold auth, cache and database code.
diagram.gateway: Single entry point for the client

goal.label: 01 · Goal
goal.p1: I wanted to build the backend and infrastructure layers end to end myself: the services, the data and how they talk to each other.
goal.p2: A messaging app is a good test for that: it needs accounts, messages and email, and each of them can run in its own service.

build.label: 02 · Structure
build.p1: Everything lives in one Turborepo monorepo, so the web app and the services share the same types and tooling.
list: The web client only talks to the API gateway.
User, chat and mail run as separate services under apps/server.
Auth, cache and database code live in shared packages, so no service copies them.
Docker Compose starts PostgreSQL, Redis and RabbitMQ locally with one command.

sections.title: Data controller
body: This notice is provided under Article 10 of the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (KVKK) and the Communiqué on the Procedures and Principles for Fulfilling the Obligation to Inform.
The data controller is Mehmet Berk Certel. Contact: m.berkcertel@outlook.com

sections.title: Personal data processed
body: When you send the contact form, the following data is processed:
list: Identity and contact: your name and email address.
Request details: the subject and timeline you choose, your message and the language of the form.
Transaction security: your IP address and Cloudflare Turnstile verification data.

sections.title: Visiting the site
body: The IP address and browser information of everyone who visits the site are processed in the server logs of the hosting provider Vercel, for security and to keep the site running.
For what is kept in your browser, see the <cookies>Cookie Policy</cookies>.

sections.title: Purposes and legal bases
list: Replying to your message and assessing your request (name, email, subject, timeline, message, language): KVKK Art. 5/2-c, directly related to the establishment of a contract.
Protecting the form against spam and abuse (IP address, Turnstile verification data): KVKK Art. 5/2-f, legitimate interest.
Serving the site securely and keeping it running (visitors’ IP address and browser information, Vercel server logs): KVKK Art. 5/2-f, legitimate interest.
Transferring form data to service providers located abroad: your explicit consent under KVKK Art. 9, given with a separate checkbox on the form.

sections.title: Method of collection
body: The data is collected electronically when you fill in and send the contact form on this site. Your IP address and the verification data are created automatically when the form is sent, and server logs when you visit the site.
I do not use your data for marketing, newsletters or profiling.

The short note above the form summarises this notice. Consent to the transfer abroad is asked separately, with its own checkbox. You do not have to give it; if you would rather not, you can write to me directly at m.berkcertel@outlook.com instead of using the form.

sections.title: Transfers
body: Your data is shared only with the service providers below, and only as far as each service needs it. Their servers may be located abroad (KVKK Art. 9).
list: Google (Gmail): delivering your message to me by email and keeping it in my inbox.
Cloudflare (Turnstile): spam checks; your IP address and the verification data are sent to Cloudflare.
Vercel: hosting the site; visitors’ IP address and browser information are processed in server logs, and form data passes through Vercel’s servers when it is sent.

sections.title: Retention
body: Form data is not stored in a database. Your message is kept only in my inbox, for as long as our conversation needs it. I delete it when you ask me to.

sections.title: Your rights under KVKK Art. 11
body: By contacting the data controller, you can:
list: Learn whether your personal data is processed.
Request information about it if it is.
Learn the purpose of the processing and whether the data is used for that purpose.
Know the third parties in Türkiye or abroad to whom it is transferred.
Ask for it to be corrected if it is incomplete or inaccurate.
Ask for it to be erased or destroyed under KVKK Art. 7.
Ask for third parties who received the data to be notified of any correction, erasure or destruction.
Object to a result against you that arises only from analysis by automated systems.
Claim compensation if you suffer damage from unlawful processing.

sections.title: How to apply
body: To use your rights or withdraw your consent, send an email with your name and request to m.berkcertel@outlook.com. I will resolve your request within 30 days at the latest.
Withdrawing your consent does not affect processing carried out before the withdrawal.

sections.title: In short
body: This site uses no advertising, analytics or tracking cookies. The site does not set cookies of its own, so it does not ask for cookie consent.
When you visit the site, your IP address and browser information are processed without cookies in the server logs of the hosting provider Vercel, for security and to keep the site running.
How personal data is processed is explained in the <privacy>Privacy Notice</privacy>.

sections.title: The preference kept in your browser
body: If you choose the light or dark theme with the theme button, your choice is kept in your browser’s local storage (localStorage) under the name “theme”. It is never sent to the server; it is only used to open the site with the same theme next time.
If you never choose a theme, nothing is stored and your device setting is used.

sections.title: Spam protection (Cloudflare Turnstile)
body: The form on the contact page uses Cloudflare Turnstile for spam checks. Turnstile loads only on the contact page. To confirm that you are human, it processes data such as your IP address and technical information about your browser, for security purposes.
This data is processed by Cloudflare and is subject to Cloudflare’s own privacy policy.

sections.title: How to delete it
body: You can change your theme at any time with the theme button. To remove it completely, clear this site’s data in your browser settings; in most browsers this is under Privacy or Site data.

sections.title: Changes
body: If I start using an analytics or marketing tool on this site, I will update this page and ask for your consent before those tools are used.
